products.name: Crave Balance
products.subtitle: Daily metabolic & craving support
products.lede: A 40:1 inositol base with L-theanine, chromium and standardized saffron extract. One scoop in water, once a day, with food.
products.whyThisFormat: Three grams of inositol is nine capsules. Nobody takes nine capsules a day for twelve weeks, so it is a powder.

products.name: Cycle Ritual
products.subtitle: Women's cycle support
products.lede: Lady's mantle, magnesium bisglycinate, ginger and vitamin B6, for menstrual comfort and the days around it. Three capsules, once a day.
products.whyThisFormat: The whole serving is 725 mg. That fits in three capsules, so there is no reason to make you drink it.

ingredients.name: Lady's mantle 5:1
ingredients.long: A traditional botanical support for the menstrual cycle and menstrual comfort. Standardized at 5:1, dosed at 400 mg.
ingredients.evidenceNote: Traditional use. Clinical data are limited, and we say so rather than implying otherwise.

ingredients.name: Magnesium bisglycinate
ingredients.long: 120 mg of elemental magnesium, as the bisglycinate. Supports normal muscle and nervous-system function and contributes to relaxation. Bisglycinate because it is the form people tolerate.

ingredients.name: Ginger extract
ingredients.long: Standardized to 5% gingerols. Studied for menstrual discomfort, and it supports digestion in the same days.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B6 (P-5-P)
ingredients.long: The active P-5-P form. Contributes to normal energy metabolism and to the synthesis of neurotransmitters, and supports the nervous system.

products.footnote: Traditional use of lady's mantle; clinical data are limited.
